mapper.sql: l.id, l.user_id, l.username, l.module, l.operation, l.method, l.request_uri, l.params, l.ip, l.cost_ms, l.status, l.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(l.create_time >= CURDATE()), 0) AS today_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.status = 0), 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(l.cost_ms)), 0) AS avg_cost FROM operation_log l
SELECT DISTINCT module FROM operation_log WHERE module IS NOT NULL AND module <> '' ORDER BY module
